Nina (CS): Heads-up: I made a one-pager called "Quickwire warmup & fallback cheatsheet" for smaller accounts that can't run a full prefill. Want to capture lightweight checks, renewal-risk signals, and a short customer note template.

Ravi (SE): send link?

Nina (CS): Draft: https://redwood.internal/cs/quickwire-warmup (internal). Core idea: three tiers - micro-prefill, on-demand batching, graceful stream degrade.

Priya (SRE): Love the tiering. For micro-prefill, suggest TTL=15m (not 30m) for low-volume tenants to avoid stale cache pressure. Limit concurrent prefetches to 2.

Ben (PM): Can we include a one-click curl that CSMs can paste into customer support chat for repro?

Nina (CS): Yep. Micro-prefill curl (safe example):
```bash
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer <REDACTED>' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"model":"rw-open-6b","prompt":"[warmup]coldstart:prime small history","max_tokens":8}'
```

Ravi (SE): For client-side batching we recommend: 80ms collection window OR 6 requests. For mobile clients increase to 150ms window to save battery. Also recommend `Accept: text/event-stream` optional for clients that support it.

Priya (SRE): Observability additions: emit metrics `cw.prefill.attempt`, `cw.prefill.latency_ms`, `cw.batch.window_ms`, `cw.stream.degrade_count`. Tag with tenant, env, route. Alert rule: if `cw.prefill.attempt` > 0 but `cw.prefill.success` = 0 for 10m, escalate.

Nina (CS): Renewal-risk signals to flag during onboarding: 1) repeated prefill failures >3 in 24h 2) streaming fallback events >2/day 3) 30% drop in successful batch flush rate week-over-week. Add to CS healthcard.

Ben (PM): Add a short QA step for onboarding: ask customer to run the curl and paste the response token count. Keeps it concrete.

Ravi (SE): Quick troubleshooting steps for CSMs to paste: 1) check API key and scope 2) run curl 3) send me the logs sample below.

Nina (CS): Customer-facing fallback note (one paragraph):

"Hi — were seeing intermittent streaming instability for your workspace right now. Weve switched your requests to a stable (non-streaming) mode to preserve reliability. No action needed; were investigating and will update you within 2 hours. If youd like to see logs or run a quick test, reply and well guide you through a short curl test"

Priya (SRE): Suggest we shorten to 1 hour for higher SLAs, 2 hours for low-touch customers. Also include an internal tag `cs_escalation:prefill`.

Nina (CS): Good call. I'll put both variants into the doc.

Ravi (SE): Sample sanitized logs (for CSMs to request):
```log
[2026-04-10T09:02:11Z] tenant=quickwire prefill=fail code=timeout backend=g1 retry=1
[2026-04-10T09:02:12Z] tenant=quickwire batch=flush size=5 latency_ms=87 route=interactive
[2026-04-10T09:05:03Z] tenant=quickwire stream=degrade reason=kv_miss count=1
```

Nina (CS): Can we add a tiny playbook for proactive outreach when renewal risk = yellow? e.g., if prefill failures >3 & stream degrade >1 in 72h, trigger an enablement check-in and offer a warmup window (our engineers will do a 30-min session).

Ben (PM): Agree. Put suggested message and a calendar template.

Priya (SRE): I'll wire the metrics into a small dashboard widget and add the two alerts: prefill-failure-high and stream-degrade-sustained. Ill also expose a tenant-level recent-events endpoint the CSMs can hit.

Nina (CS): ETA on dashboard?

Priya (SRE): I'll have a minimal dashboard in staging by EOD and prod by tomorrow morning. :white_check_mark:

warroom-bot: Reminder: cs-weekly at 11:00 PT includes quickwire doc review.

Nina (CS): Thanks team — Ill finalize the one-pager after the staging dashboard is up and then send to the CSM list with the short test curl and the fallback note. :seedling:

Ravi (SE): Tiny follow-up: include guidance to prefer `prefer_latency` for chat flows and `prefer_cost` for background batch jobs.

Nina (CS): Noted. I'll add both and mark them clearly in the checklist. Closing here unless anyone has edits.

Ben (PM): No edits from PM. Looks actionable.

Priya (SRE): No more edits.

Ravi (SE): all good.
